name: avatar
purpose: Picture of a person or entity with fallbacks: the image, then initials from the name, then an optional icon. One image to assistive technology, named after the person and their presence status; decorative when the name is shown next to it.
whenToUse: Identifying people in lists, comments, assignments, and headers.
Showing presence (online, away, busy, offline) next to a person.
whenNotToUse: Several people on one record: use Avatar Group.
Content images or logos that are not identities: use an img element.
responsive: Fixed size per size step (1.5rem to 4rem); initials and the status dot scale with it.
rtl: The status dot sits at the bottom inline-end corner (mirrored in RTL).
theme: Initials use component tokens avatar-fg on avatar-bg (contrast gate pair); avatar-square-radius for the square shape. Status dots use color-success-fg, color-warning-fg, color-error-fg, and color-text-muted, each with its own shape (busy has a bar, offline is hollow). Forced-colors mode draws a CanvasText boundary.
security: src is validated: http(s), relative, blob:, or base64 data URLs of PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, or AVIF images; javascript:, SVG data URLs, and other schemes are rejected. The image has an empty alt, no referrer, and lazy loading. Names are rendered with textContent.
dataHandling: Only the img element loads src (no-referrer). No persistence, other network access, or telemetry.

performance.testedScale: Unit-tested per instance; one avatar per row in lists of thousands is expected.

limitations: A failed image is not retried until src changes.
Initials use the first and last word of the name; names written family-name-first show those initials in that order.
unsupported: Clickable avatars (wrap the avatar in a link or button that carries the name).
antiPatterns: Showing presence by color alone without the status in text where it matters.
Reading the name twice: set decorative when the name is printed beside the avatar.
